findings.title: Unresolved initial-paused data is presented as an empty source
findings.mechanism: SourceBoundary selects skeletons from caller loading (query.isLoading), not status=initial. A no-retained paused query has status initial/isRefreshBlocked=true but isLoading=false; StaleRefreshWarning returns null without data, then empty=!health or !motorLatest renders No data. Similar isLoading-fed chart branches label unresolved rows empty.

Do not invent offline/error, spin indefinitely, or fabricate zero. Include retained/initial-paused covering proof only after separately authorized source changes.
